content.title: Bitcoin, gold, AI were key drivers of 2025's record ETF inflows
content.description:
Net inflows into exchange-traded funds (ETFs) totaled a record $1.03 trillion last year, and they're already set to break that record this year, currently sitting at $1.28 trillion year to date.

Amplify ETFs CEO, Christian Magoon, joins Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to explain where money was going in 2025 and what ETF trends he anticipates next year.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: IBIT Investors Are Barely Breaking Even
content.summary: Recent outflows are modest in context, but the timing of IBIT’s flows means its investors have little to show for bitcoin’s surge.

content.title: Bitcoin’s Swoon Prompts IBIT Exodus
content.summary: Investors pulled more than half a billion dollars out of BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust in just one day last week.

content.title: BlackRock’s IBIT Is Nearing $100B in AUM. Everyone Else Might Be Chasing ‘Crumbs’
content.summary: As the iShares Bitcoin Trust nears the milestone, dozens of spot-price crypto ETFs are being prepped to come to market.

content.title: 21Shares Tosses ETFs While Prepping for Spot Crypto Frenzy
content.summary: The company, which sponsors a nearly $5 billion Bitcoin ETF along with ARK, is nixing the three other ETFs in that partnership.

content.title: Hedge Funds Scooped Up Spot Bitcoin ETFs in Q1, Filings Show
content.summary: - 13-F filings show hedge funds Point72 and Citadel added to holdings of IBIT, the largest spot bitcoin ETF. - Citadel, founded by billionaire Ken Griffin, also owns spot Bitcoin ETFs ARKB, BITB and others. - Griffin’s Citadel sold massive holdings of SPY in Q1.
